answer.reason: The verses tell what was done with the stones: they were taken from the Jordan and set up at Gilgal as a memorial.

clauses.english: were taken from the midst of the Jordan, one for each tribe, and carried over
clauses.quote: took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan

clauses.english: were set up at Gilgal as a memorial of Israel's crossing on dry land
clauses.quote: those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal

doubts: JOS 4:9 mentions a separate set of twelve stones set up in the midst of Jordan; it is not marked as naming this record, so it was left out.
